purpose: A list of actions or options opened from a trigger, such as row actions or a sort order. Without a trigger it shows its own labelled trigger.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu, and the default trigger's text

props.name: items
props.description: Items ({ id, label, icon?, description?, shortcut?, danger?, disabled?, children? for a submenu }), sections ({ type: 'section', title, items }) and separators ({ type: 'separator' })

props.name: trigger
props.description: A Button or IconButton that opens it. Defaults to an outlined Button with a chevron

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Action menu, or a menu of choices with check marks. Defaults to none

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the id of the item activated

whenToUse: For actions on an item or a page: edit, duplicate, delete
For a short set of choices such as sort order
whenNotToUse: For navigation between pages — use Link, Tabs or SideNav
For choosing a form value — use Select
antiPatterns: More than one level of submenu
Hiding the only way to do a common task in a menu

anatomy: The shared list box popover with items (icon or check, label, description, shortcut, submenu chevron), section headers and separators
typography: Items `type-body1-size`; descriptions and shortcuts `type-caption-size`; section headers `type-overline-size`
states: Hover and focus `color-state-layer`; danger items `color-text-danger-action` with `color-state-layer-danger`; separators `color-border-default`
motion: Enters with `motion-easing-enter`, exits with `motion-easing-exit`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: role menu with menuitem, menuitemradio or menuitemcheckbox; sections are named groups
Enter or Space on the trigger opens it on the first item; arrows, Home, End and typeahead move; Escape closes and returns focus
Submenus open with Arrow Right and close with Arrow Left
